title: Census ACS 2020-2024 five-year state median household income with margin of error
limitations: Five-year ACS estimate pools survey responses for 2020–2024 and is expressed in 2024 inflation-adjusted dollars.
B19013_001M is an ACS margin of error, not a standard deviation or an independent statistic.
Official table-based 2024 ACS five-year B19013 Summary File is publicly downloadable without an API key; original pipe-delimited source bytes are archived in the release.
Missing and suppressed estimates are never silently replaced by zeros.
Longitudinal comparisons with overlapping ACS five-year periods require additional statistical care.
notes: Official table-based Summary File's B19013_E001 estimate and B19013_M001 margin of error correspond to ACS API variables B19013_001E and B19013_001M; GEO_ID 0400000USxx selects 50 states, DC and Puerto Rico. All source geography rows are preserved in original archive, with only 52 state-equivalent observations projected.
